_comment: Historical moments and figures, 1680-1722. Most fire once, inside a date window; 'priority' events fire as soon as they can. See docs/events.md.

morgan_at_port_royal.title: Sir Henry Morgan
morgan_at_port_royal.text: Sir Henry Morgan himself, buccaneer turned Lieutenant Governor, is holding court in a Port Royal tavern: fat, yellow with the dropsy, and still the most famous man in the Caribbean. He waves you over.

choices.result: He talks till dawn: Panama, Porto Bello, Maracaibo. You learn more in one night than in a year at sea.
choices.fail_result: He tells the same story four times and leaves you the bill.

choices.text: Ask him for a word with the governor's council
choices.result: 'A captain after my own heart,' he says, and writes a note.
He doesn't notice you leave.

morgan_dies.title: Morgan is dead
morgan_dies.text: News from Jamaica: Sir Henry Morgan is dead. They fired the guns of every ship in Port Royal harbour for him.

choices.text: Raise a glass to the old devil
choices.result: There will never be another like him.
An age is passing.

nine_years_war.title: War in Europe
nine_years_war.text: England, the Dutch and Spain have gone to war with France. There will be commissions for anyone who wants to fight, and prizes for the taking.

choices.result: The men talk of nothing but French prizes.

choices.text: Good news for the Brethren: the navies will be busy
choices.result: Fewer warships hunting pirates.
Insurance rates will soar.

port_royal_earthquake.title: Port Royal is gone
port_royal_earthquake.text: Terrible news from Jamaica: on the seventh of June an earthquake shook Port Royal into the sea. Two thousand dead, the waterfront drowned, the fort sunk. Looters are already picking over the ruins.

choices.text: Sail there with supplies for the survivors
choices.result: The survivors on the Palisadoes will remember your name.

choices.text: Sail there and pick over the wreckage
choices.result: Drowned treasure in the shallows, and English soldiers with orders to shoot looters.

choices.text: God's judgement on the wickedest city in the world
choices.result: The preachers say so, anyway.

spanish_succession.title: The War of the Spanish Succession
spanish_succession.text: The King of Spain has died without an heir, and Europe is at war over his throne: England and the Dutch against France and Spain. The Caribbean will burn again.

choices.text: Read the news to the crew
choices.result: Commissions, prizes, and Spanish silver. The men are delighted.

treasure_fleet_wreck.title: The Plate Fleet is lost
treasure_fleet_wreck.text: The whole Spanish treasure fleet, eleven ships laden with silver, has been wrecked by a hurricane on the Florida coast. The Spanish are salvaging it, and every pirate in the Caribbean is on his way.

choices.result: You set a course north. So, no doubt, is everyone else.
There'll be a battle for every bar of silver.

treasure_fleet_salvage.title: The wrecks off Florida
treasure_fleet_salvage.text: The beaches are black with Spanish salvors and their camp, guarded by soldiers. Divers bring up silver all day. Offshore, two pirate sloops are already circling.

choices.result: The camp falls in an hour. Silver by the chestful, and Spain will want your head for it.
choices.fail_result: The soldiers were ready. You pull back with your dead.

choices.text: Dive on the outer wrecks yourselves
choices.result: Five days of diving. Ten bars of silver the Spanish missed.
choices.fail_result: The sea is rough and the wrecks deep. Two divers drown for nothing.

choices.text: Prey on the pirate sloops instead
choices.result: They're loaded with stolen silver, and nobody will mourn them.

blackbeard_meeting.title: Blackbeard
blackbeard_meeting.text: A big French-built ship with forty guns heaves to beside you: the Queen Anne's Revenge. On her quarterdeck, a huge man with a black beard plaited with ribbons, slow-match smoking under his hat. Edward Teach wants a word.

choices.text: Sail in company with him for a cruise
choices.result: A month in his shadow. Prizes strike to him on sight. Your share is generous; his temper is not.

choices.text: Trade news and powder, and part friends
choices.result: He laughs like thunder and sends over a cask of rum.
choices.fail_result: He takes a fancy to some of your gold. You don't argue.

choices.result: Nobody runs from Blackbeard. You'll try.

woodes_rogers.title: Woodes Rogers comes to Nassau
woodes_rogers.text: Three warships in the harbour mouth: Captain Woodes Rogers, the new royal governor, has come to clean out Nassau. He offers the King's Pardon to every pirate who'll take it. Charles Vane has already set a fire ship loose and run.

choices.result: You swear the oath on the beach with two hundred others. How many of them mean it?
Out past the warships under full sail, black flag flying.

choices.text: Pay your respects to the new governor
choices.result: Rogers is a hard, sensible man. Nassau will be a different place.

blackbeard_dies.title: Blackbeard is dead
blackbeard_dies.text: News from Virginia: Blackbeard has been killed at Ocracoke by Lieutenant Maynard of the Royal Navy, after five pistol balls and twenty sword cuts. His head hangs from Maynard's bowsprit.

choices.result: Your old shipmates fall silent, then roar his name.
The navies are winning.

calico_jack.title: Calico Jack
calico_jack.text: A gaudy sloop flying a black flag with a skull and crossed swords: Calico Jack Rackham. Two of his crew, by the way they carry their cutlasses, are women. Anne Bonny and Mary Read, the taverns call them.

choices.result: Rackham is all show. The two women are the real thing.

choices.text: Mary Read asks to sign on with you
choices.result: She's tired of Rackham's drinking. She's a better fighter than any man aboard.
Rackham's a fool, and fools get hanged.

rackham_hanged.title: Rackham hanged
rackham_hanged.text: News from Jamaica: Calico Jack Rackham has been hanged at Gallows Point. Anne Bonny and Mary Read escaped the rope by 'pleading their bellies'. Bonny's last words to Jack: 'If you'd fought like a man, you need not have been hanged like a dog.'

choices.result: The gibbet at Port Royal is never empty these days.

black_bart.title: Black Bart
black_bart.text: Four sail hull-up to windward: Bartholomew Roberts' squadron, the most successful pirate of the age. He neither drinks nor gambles, and he has taken four hundred ships. A boat comes across with an invitation, or a demand.

choices.text: Join his squadron for a season
choices.result: Twenty days and a dozen prizes. Roberts runs a sober, orderly, terrifying fleet.

choices.text: Pay tribute and be on your way
choices.result: His quartermaster counts it, and lets you go.
His fastest sloop gives chase.

roberts_dies.title: The end of Black Bart
roberts_dies.text: News from Africa: Bartholomew Roberts was killed by grapeshot off Cape Lopez, fighting HMS Swallow. His crew threw his body overboard, still in his finery, as he'd asked. With him, they say, the golden age is over.

choices.result: Fewer pirates every year, and more gibbets.

kings_pardon_proclaimed.title: The King's Pardon
kings_pardon_proclaimed.text: A proclamation is read at every harbour: King George will pardon every pirate who surrenders to a governor within the year. Afterwards, no mercy.

choices.result: Some of your crew suddenly have families to think of.
The seas will be safer, perhaps.
